title: ConfigErrors
description: Written to standard error, with exit status 2, in JSON mode when the settings files can't be read (COM-121, COM-123, COM-132 to COM-134, CONFIG-005) or the workspace can't be loaded (COM-071).

field.description: The setting at fault (backend, or the backend's: linux, workfile, ...), or the resource: config.json (a settings file that isn't a JSON object); where the backend is linux also compat-index, validation.json, dt-schema, tools, deploy. A problem of a settings file names the key as the file has it: an unknown top-level key or a backend's section that isn't an object by itself (devicetree, linux, COM-132, COM-134), a key of the active section as <id>.<key> (linux.bogus, linux.devicetree, COM-123, COM-133).

hint.description: What to do about this error; given for the problems of a settings file (COM-121, COM-132 to COM-134).

hints.description: What to do about the errors, each once.
